title: Time Rift Arcade
specs: Over 100 classic and modern arcade games including pinball, rhythm, and real action games
Free play on all arcade, pinball, and real-action games with admission
Anyone 4 and over requires admission; 4 and under free with paid adult
Kids under 16 require an adult parent or guardian to remain on-site
Party participants pay $12 admission; tables first come first serve unless reserved
includes: All arcade, pinball, and real-action games set to free play and covered under admission fee
blurb: Time Rift Arcade offers a flat $12 day pass for unlimited play on arcade, pinball, and real-action games. The arcade is family friendly until 8PM, after which it is 21+ only. They have a menu of concession style food and a selection of beer, wine, cider, and frozen drinks for adults.
extraNote: Claw prize machines not included in admission and require additional payment · No outside food allowed except birthday cakes and possibly party room rentals · No smoking or vaping inside the arcade · Vouchers for educators are for students only, not valid for groups or adults
